app.title: Aplexica
app.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please relaunch from the tray menu.

bootstrap.failedBody: The launch link couldn't be verified. Try again, or reopen Aplexica Portal from the tray menu.

deployMode.localTooltip: You are connected to aplexicad on this machine.

connect.title: Connect to Aplexica Cloud
connect.subtitle: Pair this device with your Aplexica Cloud account to sync routing rules and manage it from anywhere.
connect.loadError: Couldn't load the cloud connection status.

notConfigured.title: Cloud plugin not installed
notConfigured.body: This daemon doesn't have the Aplexica Cloud plugin configured, so there's nothing to pair yet. Install and enable the cloud plugin on this machine, then come back to this page.
notConfigured.hint: The cloud plugin is an optional add-on that connects this device to app.aplexica.com.

getCode.title: Get a pairing code
getCode.body: Open the Aplexica Cloud portal, click “Pair a new device,” and copy the one-time pairing code it shows you.
getCode.note: The code is valid for a few minutes — grab a fresh one if it expires before you finish.

pasteCode.title: Paste the code
pasteCode.body: Paste the pairing code from the cloud portal below. Optionally give this device a friendly name so you can recognize it later.
pasteCode.tokenPlaceholder: Paste your pairing code (starts with eyJ…)
pasteCode.tokenRequired: Paste the pairing code to continue.

pair.title: Pair this device
pair.body: We'll exchange your pairing code for a device certificate and connect this machine to Aplexica Cloud.

errors.title: Pairing failed
errors.remoteNotConfigured: The cloud plugin isn't configured on this daemon. Install and enable the Aplexica Cloud plugin, then try again.
errors.validation: That code looks invalid or expired — generate a fresh one in the cloud portal.
errors.pairFailed: The server couldn't complete pairing. Your code may have expired or already been used.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while pairing. Please try again.

success.title: Paired with Aplexica Cloud
success.subtitleConnected: This device is paired and its relay session is connected.
success.subtitleDisconnected: This device is paired, but its live relay session is disconnected.
success.rulesNote: Routing rules now sync from Aplexica Cloud. Manage them from the cloud portal and they'll apply here automatically.
success.relayDisconnectedNote: This machine is paired, but the daemon is not currently holding a live relay session. Cloud sync resumes when the daemon reconnects.
success.verifyDisconnected: Not currently connected to the cloud relay.
success.verifyError: Couldn't reach the cloud relay. Please try again.
success.unpairNote: Removes this device's credentials and stops cloud sync here. To also remove it from your account, open the cloud portal's Devices page and click Revoke.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Live status of the Aplexica daemon and the agents it keeps in sync.

events.title: Recent activity
events.none: No events yet. Activity will appear here as Aplexica syncs.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: AI coding agents on this machine. Aplexica keeps their memory, skills and tools in sync.
agents.empty: No adapters detected. Install a supported AI agent and Aplexica will pick it up automatically.
agents.notDetectedSub: Supported, but not found on this machine yet
agents.artifactsTip: Memory, skills and tools from this agent currently in Aplexica’s canonical store.
agents.adapterVersionTip: Version of the Aplexica adapter for this agent — not the agent’s own version.
agents.agentVersionTip: The agent’s own installed version. Detection is coming soon — shown as — for now.

fanOut.tip: Cross-agent fan-out: when on, other agents' artifacts are replicated into this agent. Discovery + import happen regardless.

agents.installHint: Install {name} and Aplexica will detect it automatically — no configuration needed.

detail.noEvents: No recent events for this agent.
detail.noNamespaces: This agent has no namespaces yet.
detail.noRoots: No native storage detected for this agent.

idle.label: Idle
idle.tip: Connected and healthy — nothing is syncing at the moment.

paused.label: Paused
paused.tip: Sync is paused for this agent. Resume from the dashboard.

error.label: Attention
error.tip: This agent hit an error or was quarantined. Check conflicts and events.

notInstalled.label: Not installed
notInstalled.tip: This agent isn’t installed on this machine. Install it and Aplexica detects it automatically.

events.title: Event stream
events.subtitle: Live activity from the daemon plus paginated backfill.
events.collapseTip: Fold repeated live pings and re-syncs into one row each instead of a row per event.

rules.title: Routing rules
rules.subtitle: Decide which artifacts fan out to which agents.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Aplexica syncs nothing across agents until you add a rule — start from a preset or write your own.
rules.cloudBadgeHint: This rule is managed in the cloud portal and is read-only on this device.

form.typesHint: Leave empty to match every artifact type.
form.agentsHint: Leave empty for all installed agents. Pick the originating agent to route back to whichever agent created the artifact.
form.syncOffDeviceHint: Turn off to keep matching artifacts local only (never sent to a relay or other device).
form.includeSecretsHint: Turn off to sync tool artifacts without their secret values.

presets.title: Add from preset
presets.subtitle: Opt into Aplexica's classic routing behavior. Each preset adds one rule (or, for the starter set, several) you can edit afterward.

detail.nameDisabledNote: Renaming isn't supported here — delete this rule and create a new one to change its name.
detail.advancedNote: These predicates aren't editable from this form. They're preserved when you save and can be changed in ~/.aplexica/rules.toml.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? It will not be recoverable.
detail.cloudNote: This rule is managed in your cloud account and applies to this device read-only. Edit or remove it from the cloud portal's Routing rules page.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.subtitle: Same artifact, divergent heads. Pick the winning side or merge manually.
conflicts.emptyBody: Nothing needs a conflict-resolution decision right now.

detail.analysisMissing: Aplexica could not load the readable conflict analysis. Use the raw previews below to choose a side.
detail.noVisibleDifference: No visible turn or line difference was found. This usually means metadata, hidden context, timestamps, or formatting changed.
detail.autoResolvable: This conflict can be settled automatically by keeping Head {head}, the newest equivalent head.
detail.noActionRequired: No choice is needed. Aplexica removed this equivalent conflict from the active list.

forking.title: Forking
forking.subtitle: Create alternate conversation branches and choose which branch each agent should materialize.
forking.searchPlaceholder: Search by prompt, short description, agent, or artifact ID...
forking.selectBody: Branch controls appear here after you choose a conversation from the list.
forking.noConversationsBody: Aplexica has not imported any conversation artifacts yet.
forking.noResultsBody: Try a word from the prompt, an agent name, or the artifact ID.

conversationBranches.title: Conversation branches
conversationBranches.subtitle: Fork from an existing branch head, or switch an agent to a saved branch.

fork.title: Fork
fork.description: Create a new branch from the selected point, then open that new branch in the target agent.

checkout.title: Check out
checkout.description: Switch an agent to an existing branch without creating another branch.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Protect native agent state locally or as client-encrypted cloud backups.
backups.emptyBody: Create a manual backup or enable a schedule to start the history.
backups.noSnapshotsBody: Only reversible restore undo points are present.

destination.cloudReady: Encrypted before upload; restore requires this local key.
destination.cloudUnavailable: Connect to Aplexica Cloud to enable encrypted cloud backups.

safety.title: Safety status
safety.emptyBody: Detected agents with native state will appear here.
safety.overrideError: Could not override the backup blocker.

retention.title: History limits
retention.body: Manual and scheduled backup history is kept per agent. Safety snapshots and restore undo points are preserved separately.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete backup
deleteConfirm.localWarning: This removes the local snapshot directory. If it is the current safety snapshot for an agent, that agent will require a new backup before guarded sync can continue.
deleteConfirm.cloudWarning: This removes the encrypted cloud backup object and its metadata. The cloud cannot recover it after deletion.

preRestore.title: Reversible undo points
preRestore.subtitle: Snapshots Aplexica took automatically before each restore, so any restore can itself be undone.

confirm.title: Restore backup
confirm.body: This overwrites the live native state of {scope} with the files in this snapshot.
confirm.warning: This is destructive: current native agent files will be replaced. Aplexica first takes a reversible snapshot of the current state, but the active agents' working data will change.
confirm.cloudWarning: This encrypted cloud backup will be downloaded and decrypted locally before restore. The cloud cannot decrypt it; this device's local key is required.
confirm.partial: Restore finished with errors: {failed} of {total} files failed.

pending.title: Pending projects
pending.subtitle: Approve discovered folders, or link recognized imported projects to a local folder.
pending.empty: No pending projects. Folders your agents work in will show up here for approval.

source.discoveredTip: Aplexica found one or more agents working in this folder.
source.artifactTip: Surfaced from imported artifacts that preserved a local folder path.
source.pathlessArtifactTip: Aplexica found project-scoped artifacts, but they did not include a local folder path.

denied.title: Dismissed
denied.subtitle: Projects you dismissed. They won't reappear in the pending list unless you restore them.

suggestions.title: Agent suggestions
suggestions.subtitle: An agent started working in a project it isn't syncing yet. Add it, or dismiss the suggestion.

approveDialog.title: Approve project
approveDialog.scopeHint: Folder-local keeps rules scoped to this folder. Global applies your global routing to it.
approveDialog.agentsHint: Only the selected agents receive this folder's context. Pre-filled from the agents seen running here. Selecting every agent means all agents (including ones installed later).

linkDialog.title: Link project ID {id}
linkDialog.help: Choose the existing local folder that belongs to this project ID. If you do not recognize it, dismiss it instead.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Folders Aplexica is replicating context for, with the scope and agents each is registered under.
projects.empty: No projects registered yet. Approve a pending folder or add one manually.

agentsEdit.label: Agents that sync here
agentsEdit.hint: Only the selected agents receive this folder's context. Selecting every agent means all agents (including ones installed later).

memory.title: Effective memory
memory.subtitle: What each agent actually holds for this folder. Layouts differ (Claude splits into ~/.claude/.../memory), but the content should match.
memory.empty: No project memory synced for this folder yet.

toast.removed: Project removed — it can re-appear in Pending

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Safe-to-edit knobs. For the rest, open ~/.aplexica/config.toml.

form.hermesWatchIntervalHelp: How often Aplexica polls Hermes state.db for new or changed conversation sessions. Use a Go duration such as 5s, 30s, or 1m.

transport.title: Transport
transport.subtitle: How Aplexica reaches out beyond this machine.
transport.localOnlyNotice: This daemon currently exposes local-only transport. Remote relay controls are unavailable in this build.

byo.title: Bring-your-own relay
byo.unavailable: BYO relay is not available from this daemon. Use a build that advertises the byo-relay transport before configuring it here.
byo.comingSoon: BYO relay configuration is not available in this build.

toast.byoDeferred: BYO relay is not available in this build.
toast.byoUnavailable: BYO relay is not available in this daemon build.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Pointers to the docs, source, and support.

items.docsBody: Read the full guide on www.aplexica.com/docs.
items.sourceBody: Both the daemon and this UI are AGPL-3.0. Browse them on GitHub.
items.trayBody: If you closed this tab, click "Open Aplexica" in the system tray to relaunch.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Aplexica
onboarding.subtitle: We'll get you set up in a few minutes.

install-daemon.title: Install the daemon
install-daemon.body: The aplexicad daemon is what makes everything work. You're already connected — this step is complete.

detect-agents.title: Connect your agents
detect-agents.body: Install one of the supported agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Kilo). Aplexica will detect them automatically.
detect-agents.pending: Waiting for the first adapter to appear…

first-sync.title: Wait for your first sync
first-sync.body: Use any of your agents normally. Aplexica will replicate everything it produces.
first-sync.pending: Waiting for the first sync event…

done.title: You're set up
done.body: Head to the dashboard to see your daemon, agents, and a live event feed.
